subject: Deployment mode decision & MAP: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cerebrohealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deployment mode and region: MAP request and timeline

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Cerebro is leaning into a generative assistant pilot for our clinician workflow and we need to lock the deployment decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and region within the next 3–4 weeks to meet our Q4 launch cadence.

Can you share a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation plan, milestone dates, criteria for pass/fail, and a recommended default if we need to choose quickly? We also need SOC2 artifacts and a rough estimate for Dedicated capacity pricing (monthly committed) so procurement can budget.

High level asks:
- Evaluation PoC scope (tokens, latency SLOs, sample prompts)
- Timeline to decision (recommended milestones and who needs to sign off)
- Procurement docs we should expect (SOW, invoice timing, terms)

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful. Legal contact will be Ana Ross (cc later once I confirm).

Best,
Samir
Director of Platform Engineering
Cerebro Health
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode and region: MAP request and timeline

Samir — thanks, this is timely. I put together an initial MAP and an evaluation playbook attached (Cerebro_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) that maps PoC milestones to decision gates for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private. Quick summary up front:

- Recommended near-term path: Hosted US-east for rapid onramp (2–4 week PoC), with a parallel Dedicated evaluation lane if you surface strict throughput or isolation requirements.
- If procurement requires contractual isolation or on-prem constraints, Private is feasible but adds 6–10 weeks for network and infra validation.

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) Kickoff & env prep (week 0): share prompts, sample data, and access policy
2) PoC baseline (week 1–2): throughput/latency run, quality checks vs baseline prompts
3) Security & compliance validation (week 2–3): SOC2 artifacts, penetration test schedule
4) Final decision checkpoint (week 3–4): select mode and sign SOW / commit

I've asked Ben to include a pricing starter (Committed Dedicated seat vs hosted run rate) and Sean will add the PoC technical parameters and SOC2 materials.

Attachments: Cerebro_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Next steps: can we lock a 30–45 minute alignment call this Wednesday or Thursday? Also please confirm Ana's legal email and your procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Deployment mode and region: MAP request and timeline

Adding pricing context for the thread. Estimated starter numbers (placeholder, final after usage profile):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): $0.0008 / token (generation) with tooling credits; no commit required.
- Dedicated (reserved pool): $18k / GPU-month (example) — typical Mid-market commitment for a 2 node pool to meet 5–10 qps at p50 latency targets. We can model a 3–6 month committed price with a 10–20% volume discount depending on term.
- Private/on-prem: one-time infra integration fee (~$40k–$60k) + support/maintenance.

Deal mechanics: if they want a short decision window (3–4 weeks), Hosted with a parallel Dedicated sizing PoC is the lowest friction: we can run live traffic on Hosted and emulate Dedicated throughput in our staging infra to produce a sizing report. Procurement will expect a draft SOW — I can push a SOW-draft template by end of day if Priya confirms scope.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Deployment mode and region: MAP request and timeline

Technical notes for the MAP / evaluation:
- PoC targets: 5k daily active tokens, p95 latency < 350ms (US-east), and top-line quality thresholds based on the provided prompt set.
- Hosted is fastest: zero infra lead time, but for strict SLAs we recommend Dedicated with reserved pools and autoscale policy.
- Private: supports air-gapped scenarios and customer-managed KMS, but will need network review and a 4–6 week window for acceptance testing.

Attached: SOC2-evidence.zip (redacted artifacts: controls matrix, SOC2 summary) and a short technical appendix in the shared Drive.

I'll also spin up a lightweight Dedicated-sim runbook to surface expected CPU/GPU utilization so Ben can model committed pricing precisely.

- Sean
